notes.title: Woo'z Da Boss Update !
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/58cb8a5ab0d74f389e382b7655cc0bc24394927a.jpg

I have updated Woo'z Da Boss :

- Bullet Warp can be purchased multiple times
- Proton Canon can be purchased multiple times
- Shield (single) can be purchased multiple times
- +1 HP can be purchased multiple times
- The skill "Dash" can now dodge shots and enemies

New skills added : 

- Shield (40 hits) can be purchased multiple times
- Bullet time can be purchased multiple times

Missile skill has been fixed.

These adjustments allow you to go even further in waves of enemies.

notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/497b39ab0cf22305543dd03b7ea97c45d900eef2.pngKey mapping - Gamepad and Keyboard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/58a1403947dc31bb9f21fbe6bcb94e8202351c9e.jpg

Dear Beta-testers friends, today we have added to Space Probes the possibility of mapping the keys of your favorite controller and also the possibility of mapping the keys of the keyboard. So you can set up the solution best suited to your way of playing :)

To use this new options go to the "Options" menu then "Controller".

Boss Rush in a dynamic 7th level
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/98173e3bfcfea22d1943c98f6dd5cc1904452443.jpg

This update also arrives with a 7th level that will put your reflexes to the test! 
I let you discover it for yourself!

To finish, do not hesitate to send us back the various bugs that you may have encountered so that we can work on it.

The update is available immediately! Good Game everyone

See you soon !
